objective: Make owner waiting truthful, durable and resumable: a phase that reserves an action to Murad stops and records the wait, and a later run recovers that wait from durable state, validates his committed receipt against the subject the wait was raised at, spends it exactly once under an exclusive lock, and resumes — refusing any stale, foreign, replayed or unprovable decision.
